name: Misaki
source:
A ojou-sama of the highest caste. She is polite on the outside, and is dark-hearted on the inside. She bullies the protagonist for being on the lowest caste.

She is highly egotistical. She likes to be pampered by men, but has never been in a relationship. She has a rivalry with Kirari.
